abstract: A case of primary mediastinal germ cell tumor, which was radically treated with reconstruction of the superior vena cava (SVC) after neoadjuvant chemotherapy, is reported herein. This tumor, accompanied with SVC syndrome, was initially unresectably advanced and chemotherapy, using cis-dichlorodiamine-platinum, vindesine and bleomycin, was administered, resulting in a partial response with a 65 per cent tumor regression. The serum human chorionic gonadotropin, which originally had a high value, became reduced in parallel with the tumor regression to within the normal range. Complete tumor resection with reconstruction of the SVC using an expanded polytetrafluoroethylene (EPTFE) graft was successfully performed. The patient has now returned to productive employment and the graft is patent without any clinical symptoms of recurrence, 15 months post-operatively. Neoadjuvant chemotherapy is considered to be vitally important for the treatment of germ cell tumors originating in the anterior mediastinum and an EPTFE graft with external ring support seems to be acceptable as an artificial substitute for SVC replacement.
abstract_ja: 原発性縦隔胚細胞腫瘍の1例を報告する。上大静脈症候群を伴い、当初切除不能と判断された症例である。シス-ジクロロジアミン白金（シスプラチン）、ビンデシン、ブレオマイシンによる化学療法が行われ、腫瘍は65%縮小して部分奏効が得られた。血清hCG値は当初高値であったが、腫瘍の縮小に伴って正常範囲まで低下した。拡張型ポリテトラフルオロエチレン（ePTFE）人工血管を用いた上大静脈の再建を伴い、腫瘍の完全切除が行われた。術後15か月の時点で患者は就労に復帰しており、移植血管の開存は保たれ、再発を示す臨床症状もない。縦隔前部の胚細胞腫瘍の治療においては術前化学療法が極めて重要であり、外側をリングで支持した人工血管は上大静脈の代用物として許容できると考えられる。
